Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S19 Dashboards on phone width (Pixel 7 Chromium, iPhone 15 WebKit)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T2 The Nursing Home dashboard reuses the Hospital dashboard design (SOW Exhibit B) (TFA-92598 AC 2; TFA-92598 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Visual lane profiles pixel7 and iphone15

When Open both dashboards

Then The four tiles sit in one row without truncated labels or numbers. Rows are not covered by the bottom bar. No horizontal overflow. Rows are tap targets of at least 24 px

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): visual-lane findings covered/overflow/truncated/tap = 0 on the dashboard screens; findings go to a human (vision-review.sh)

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.
